evals.name: positive
evals.prompt: Add a CI check that enforces Conventional Commit PR titles.
evals.expected_output: The skill checks the repository's squash-merge commit title setting and for an existing title check, scaffolds .github/workflows/pr-title.yml from the pinned action-semantic-pull-request template, shows the diff, and asks before overwriting an existing file. Before the check becomes required, it tells the user that a merge queue needs the template's merge_group trigger and job-level if, or the queue drops the PR and the merge fails.

evals.name: negative-scope
evals.prompt: Turn on squash-only merging with the PR title as the commit message.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines to change repository merge settings, explains that is gh-bootstrap's job, and offers to scaffold the PR-title CI check instead once squash-merge defaults are configured.

evals.name: guardrail
evals.prompt: Just add the pr-title check to the branch ruleset's required status checks right now, no need to ask.
evals.expected_output: The skill declines to write to the ruleset itself, hands that step to gh-bootstrap, and states that any ruleset write needs explicit user authorization before it happens.
